verdict.rationale: Snyk Open Source documents actionable fix advice and pull-request-based fix workflows. The CLI reports the dependency path and fix guidance for each issue and advertises automatic fixing, and the Remediation Agent (`snyk fix --agentic`, `/snyk-fix`) plans, applies and verifies fixes. Hands-on community reports confirm the automated dependency PRs exist but describe them as noisy: dozens or hundreds of PRs, point-release bumps that skip versions, and wrongly replacing forked packages. That is a quality caveat, not a contradiction of the capability. Missing for 10: detailed docs on upgrade-path mechanics (e.g. minimal-upgrade selection, transitive handling), positive independent corroboration of fix-PR quality.
